core_obligations: Only-if (proof lines 1253-1270): assume the inverse-box inclusion and a Diamond A from Delta; if Box not-A sat in Gamma, its not-A would populate the inverse image inside Delta, contradicting A's membership there - so maximality admits Diamond A into Gamma.

If-direction (lines 1307-1315): contrapositive: A missing from Delta puts not-A in Delta, Diamond not-A enters Gamma by hypothesis, duality rewrites it as not Box A, consistency then excludes Box A from Gamma.
proof_roadmap: Translate membership across the negation gate.
Use modal duality to switch sides of the inclusion.
